status: v2 deterministic detail topology; independent re-review required before builder use

axes.gltf: Blender exporter converts Z-up to glTF Y-up; builder must audit exported bounds rather than pre-swizzle vertices.

connectedTerraces.name: upper_cap_facets
sequence: for s=1..3 and i in [2,3], replace Q[s][i] with C[s][i] four-triangle fan
cap end rings after every replacement
connectedTerraces.meaning: a recessed, faceted cap band; negative Z only, so station 1 remains the 1.60m maximum
connectedTerraces.sharedAttachment: C[s][i] is welded to all four original Q corners; adjacent unaffected quads retain their original shared ring edges

connectedTerraces.name: front_bedding_ledge
sequence: for s=0..5 replace Q[s][1] with C[s][1] four-triangle fan
triangulate with fixed winding shown in topologyConvention
connectedTerraces.meaning: a continuous recessed upper-front band, leaving loop 1/adjacent lower face proud as the shallow bedding ledge; +Y is inward because the front is -Y
connectedTerraces.sharedAttachment: each C shares its four original host-ring corners; no new perimeter loop or separate slab

connectedTerraces.name: vertical_erosion_gullies
sequence: replace only those four Q faces using the common centre-fan recipe
do not alter Q[3][0], creating a broad intact central plane between gully groups
connectedTerraces.meaning: two shallow lower-front gully groups beneath the separate bedding band, separated by an intact central plane; all moves are inward/downward and retain the envelope
connectedTerraces.sharedAttachment: each centre fan uses only the pre-existing host quad perimeter

topologyConvention.ringOrder: R[s][i], station s=0..6 left-to-right and loop i=0..7 in declared primaryLoft order
topologyConvention.faceCenter: C[s][i]=mean(Q[s][i]) plus its listed local offset; replace Q with four triangles [R0,R1,C], [R1,R2,C], [R2,R3,C], [R3,R0,C]. C is shared by all four replacement triangles.
topologyConvention.caps: Generate after all listed face replacements: cap station 0 with ordered fan [R[0][0]..R[0][7]], cap station 6 reversed. No detail operation touches end-cap faces.
topologyConvention.attachment: All detail is an in-place replacement of an existing primary-loft quad. No duplicate shell, detached slab, boolean, or intersecting volume is allowed.

maxDepthStation.detailOffsets: all detail offsets are +Y inward from the front or -Z downward; no operation expands ±1.05m Y extent

maxHeightStation.detailOffsets: all detail offsets are -Z downward; no operation exceeds 1.60m
